snapshot.title: Time Jump — 911 System Deterioration

fields.narration: It is now 21:30. The problem has spread to multiple 911 trunks and 10-digit lines. The floor cannot maintain call integrity — 10 calls in queue, 2 with 90-second wait times. The Director has not yet declared Level 1, but the Technical Lead has manually isolated RCECD-POS09 and blocked its traffic. The TDoS-strict rule set is now active, but silent calls continue to flood the 10-digit lines. The shift must decide whether to go manual or wait for a recovery that may not come.
